collection.description: A villager's vision has grown cloudy, and a healer believes a delicate eye operation might help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A villager's vision has grown cloudy, and a healer believes a delicate eye operation might help.

choices.label: Help the villager adapt without surgery.
Consult the patient about what matters most.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager regains some sight but remains sensitive to bright light.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The eye becomes painful after surgery, and the villager loses further vision.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The villager develops reliable ways to navigate familiar paths.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A friend learns to describe written records aloud without treating the villager as helpless.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villager chooses not to risk the sight they retain.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The villager accepts the operation after understanding its uncertainty.
